drills.name: cluster-loss
drills.objective: endpoint loss remains bounded and opens the local circuit

drills.objective: a reset after dispatch never becomes an automatic retry

drills.name: pit-expiry

drills.name: migration-rollback
drills.objective: forward and reverse cutovers retain the application write fence

drills.name: migration-unknown-outcome
